presets.name: SDXL portrait (starter)
presets.routing_card: Use for photographic people and portraits when no more specific recipe applies.
presets.notes: Published SDXL defaults. Not tested on this deployment; treat every value as a starting point.

prompt_dialect.negative_prompt: blurry, lowres, jpeg artifacts, bad anatomy, watermark, text

presets.name: Illustrious booru (starter)
presets.routing_card: Use for illustrated and anime-style pictures, where booru tags describe the subject better than a sentence.
presets.notes: Published score-tag defaults for Illustrious and Pony derivatives. Not tested on this deployment.

prompt_dialect.negative_prompt: score_4, score_5, score_6, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts

presets.name: Flux (starter)
presets.routing_card: Use when the request needs strong prompt adherence, readable text in the image, or a photographic look Flux handles well.
presets.notes: Flux takes no negative prompt and wants a low guidance value. Not tested on this deployment.
